name: Micronaut Core 5.2.0
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Add RFC 10008 support (QUERY Method) by @desiderantes in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12780
* Derive configuration metadata documentation from Kotlin KDoc by @MariusVolkhart in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12831
* feat: add experimental Python support with GraalPy by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12843
* Add Netty activation controls by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12842
* feat: add incremental Python and Java compilation by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12850
* Support Python module annotations and JUnit 5 tests by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12881
* Add cross-origin policy header configuration by @sdelamo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12914
* Control the order in which singletons are destroyed by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12965
* Let AbstractConcurrentCustomScope answer for a bean definition by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12969
* Add language-neutral extension points for Scala integration by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12695
* Retain the annotations a composed annotation introduces by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12968
* Add the micronaut-reflection module by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12977
* Compile a wildcard type argument to a WildcardArgument that keeps its bounds by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13023
* Record on a bean introspection the type arguments a type binds in a super type by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13048
* Support default parameters for languages other than Kotlin by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13041
* Honour @Bean(preDestroy) on a bean class by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13066
* Let a runtime bean definition declare its injection points by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13065
* Keep the bounds of a type variable on the argument it compiles to by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13063
* Add isInherited() method to AnnotationElement interface by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13053
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Fix KSP2 crash writing aggregating outputs by @kamilkrzywanski in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12805
* Cache successful message lookups in ResourceBundleMessageSource by @el-psy-kongroo-d in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12837
* Fix bean introspection for OpenAPI generated $ref properties by @samikshathorat21 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12823
* Diagnose concrete Java inheritance in native Python by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12896
* Propagate hasEvaluatedExpressions in DefaultAnnotationMetadata copies by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12975
* Key a parameter's and a field's mutated metadata by the declaring type, not the type it is read through by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12971
* Keep a generated introspection name usable as a file name by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12967
* Resolve a repeatable annotation through its container in the by-name metadata queries by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12963
* Return the resolved values from getAnnotationValuesByName by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12978
* fix: handle discovery health without cache implementation by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12983
* Fix NoSuchMethodError when instantiating a Python bean via a @Creator classmethod by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13033
* Prefer an explicit @Head route over the implicit one derived from @Get by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13030
* Fix the endless destruction of a per-bean-locked scope holding a bean it cannot take out by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13049
* Resolve member-level @AnnotationExpressionContext in Kotlin by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13035
* fix(cookie): parse request Cookie header as name/value pairs by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13054
* Propagate the context of pre-matching filters into the route match by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13082
* Publish a refreshed property catalog atomically by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13079
* Don't instantiate an empty bean for an absent @QueryValue POJO by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13080
* Add the SslHandler for every wss connection by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13085
* Invoke the Kotlin $default method on the type that declares it by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13084
### Improvements ⭐
* Fix KSP configuration interface inheritance by @sakshichitnis27 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12814
* fix(http): @QueryValue object binding for @JsonProperty aliases with underscores by @samikshathorat21 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12803
* Handle health status for endpoint base paths by @sakshichitnis27 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12812
* Inherit HTTP/2 settings for service clients by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12800
* reject header-injection characters in default cookie encoders by @kali834x in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12753
* fix: allow validated @Value constructor params without @Introspected by @arimu1 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12859
* Add shared GraalPy context execution APIs by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12849
* Preserve original Python sources for debugging by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12874
* Fix native Python Throwable subclasses by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12893
* Allow disabling ImageSingletons lookups by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12894
* Memoize repeated Resolver calls by @Nillerr in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12897
* Fix Python pooled request-body context conversion by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12942
* Fix: Micronaut Python cannot start on a JVM without JVMCI by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12976
* Make a field resolution segment a `FieldInjectionPoint` with no outer injection point by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12970
* Let a custom scope lock bean creation per bean rather than for the whole scope by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12973
* Destroy a proxy's retained interceptors from `destroyBean(Object)` by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12972
* Expose the target constructor to constructor interceptors of proxied beans by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12959
* Honour the route's executor for Kotlin suspend functions by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13032
* Expose the beans predicate a context was built with by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13050
* Cut annotation processor CPU by profiling the Java and Python pipelines by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13060
* Add a JDT compiler test suite and fix three javac specific assumptions by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13070
* Reject AOP advice on a sealed type at compile time by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13067
* Let a method element be annotated through the default method annotation metadata by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13062
* Copy all HTTP client configuration fields by @yawkat in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12816
* Resolve a type argument bound at an intermediate generic super type by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13081
* Tell a raw type apart from a usage written with a type variable by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13086
* Add extensible response header populators by @sdelamo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12992
### Docs 📖
* Update JDK setup requirements by @sdelamo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12844
* docs: document Python threading configuration by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12984
* Document retaining composed annotations by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12989
* docs: fix guide errors and fill in missing language snippets by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13034
* Document immutable configuration with record-like types by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13057
### Dependency updates 🚀
* Update bytebuddy to v1.18.11 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12785
* Update dependency ch.qos.logback:logback-classic to v1.5.38 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12811
* Update dependency com.github.javaparser:javaparser-symbol-solver-core to v3.28.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12819
* Update dependency com.uber.nullaway:nullaway to v0.13.8 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12824
* Update Micronaut dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12736

* Update actions/setup-java digest to 03ad4de by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12754
* Update dependency com.blazebit:blaze-persistence-core-impl to v1.6.20 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12845
* Update dependency com.squareup.okio:okio to v3.18.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12852
* Update jackson monorepo by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12833
* Update graalvm/setup-graalvm digest to 5298d94 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12872
* Update actions/checkout digest to d23441a by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12839
* Update netty monorepo to v4.2.17.Final by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12876
* Update dependency io.netty:netty-tcnative-boringssl-static to v2.0.81.Final by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12889
* Update bytebuddy to v1.18.12 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12898
* Update dependency io.github.classgraph:classgraph to v4.8.192 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12901
* Upgrade GraalPy for Python modules by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12903
* Update dependency jakarta.data:jakarta.data-api to v1.1.0-M3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12905

* Update graalvm/setup-graalvm digest to 0426e2e by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12991
* upgrade graalpy version to 25.3.4.1 by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13029
* Update dependency com.squareup.okio:okio to v3.18.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13071
* Update dependency com.google.testing.compile:compile-testing to v0.23.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12295
* Update mikepenz/action-junit-report digest to a9170d5 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13013
* Update graalvm/setup-graalvm digest to 0426e2e by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13012
* Update kotlin monorepo to v2.4.10 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12815
### Other Changes 💡
* Honor configuration loading strategy during bootstrap by @fatekingsama in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12788
* fix: clear resolver caches after catalog rebuild by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12864
* fix(ksp): include Kotlin internal types in bean $EXPOSED_TYPES by @arimu1 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12857
* fix(http-client): preserve PropagatedContext for client filters with micrometer context-propagation by @arimu1 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12858
* fix: improve incremental Python compiler sessions by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12870
* test: cover implicit Python controller validation by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12878
* Fix Python module test nested-function traversal by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12883
* Add unique metadata and names for generated Python module stubs by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12892

* Exclude BC dependencies by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12904
* fix(aop): preserve toString behavior for lazy proxies by @Boulea7 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12875
* Initialize parameterized Python config beans before builder injection by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12907
* Invoke @PreDestroy methods on beans with PRE_DESTROY advice by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12920
* Fix an interceptor not matching a bean that leaves a binding member at its default by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12925
* Compare the members of a qualifier built from an annotation instance by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12928
* Allow a primitive type to be named among a bean's exposed types by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12927
* Property cache issue by @msupic in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12926
* Leave @Primary out of composite qualifiers by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12945
* Fix @InjectScope destruction for constructor parameters and prototype beans by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12934
* Allow a runtime bean definition's factory to receive the resolution context by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12937
* Honour the argument of RuntimeBeanDefinition.Builder.singleton(boolean) by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12946
* Remove a bean from the scope map when a custom scope destroys it by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12947
* Fire destruction listeners when closing a context-created bean registration by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12943
* Fix client proxy tests for updated Micronaut website by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12954
* fix(ksp): detect @JvmRepeatable when resolving repeatable containers by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12912
* fix(processor): stop generating an imported type's introspection twice by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12916
* Extend @AliasFor to support OverridesAttribute-style member overrides by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12911
* Throw IllegalStateException when resolving beans from a context that is not running by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12948
* Reuse one interceptor instance across a bean's lifecycle by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12922
* Process a class annotated only @ClassImport by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12952
* Resolve a null proxy target through the bean resolution customizer by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12951
* fix(validation): only advise methods that declare @RequiresValidation by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12919
* A bean introspection describes only the constructor it instantiates beans with by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12909
* Two startup optimisations: -5% wall, -12% CPU on cold start by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12955
* Support static methods meta-annotated as @Executable by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12957
* Close a bean registration idempotently by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12956
* Let a custom scope registered at runtime reach beans resolved before it by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12961
* Let a runtime bean definition carry its own disposer by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12964
* Describe the enclosing instance of an inner class constructor by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12966
* Find a bean definition by its compiled class by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12974
* Update introduction.adoc for clarity and accuracy by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12988
* Intercept each @PostConstruct and @PreDestroy callback separately by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12962
* Clear the quality gate of 5.2.x by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12990
* Make the declared only annotation metadata usable by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12917
* Do not assert an exact reply count in the Python websocket specs by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12996
* Read a member held in a collection value by value, as one held in an array by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12994
* Do not discard Fetch Metadata that is only partly recognised by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12999
* Expose the members a bean property is composed of by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12918
* Do not leave the bean context stuck as terminating by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13009
* Fail fast when adding a method definition after inheriting the super ones by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13000
* Do not break a destruction cycle at a bean the cycle requires by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13005
* Destroy singletons created during context shutdown by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13007
* Do not lose a bean created while a per-bean-locked scope shuts down by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13008
* Inherit the active environment in GraalPy contexts by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13011
* Enumerate beans by their @Indexed types even when not implemented by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12960
* Do not derive an interceptor binding for a kind that is already declared by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13001
* Register binder constructors for native images by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/12986
* Three unrelated cleanups in inject, inject-python and inject-kotlin by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13003
* Four fixes from a deep analysis pass: interceptor member binding, PowerPoint media type, unsafe publication, header name validation by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13004
* Reject header values holding a character above U+00FF by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13002
* Invoke the pre-destroy method of a proxied factory-produced bean by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13015
* Register the proxy synthesize() actually creates for DYNAMIC_PROXY annotations by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13014
* Track @Parallel bean startup as part of the context lifecycle by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13010
* Report a mime type table that could not be loaded by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13006
* Keep the singleton creation lock across a failed creation by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13024
* Validate constrained @Value fields and setter placeholders at inject time by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13021
* Answer the enclosing method for the outer injection point of a method argument segment by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13022
* Intercept a lifecycle event once, keeping the callbacks it exposes by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13019
* Normalize Python resource paths on Windows by @ezzarghili in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13028
* Close every bean of a per-bean-locked scope before taking any out by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13025

* Make the Python compile tasks cacheable and relocatable by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13036
* Preserve map key spelling for indexed keys in the RAW property catalog by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13039
* Recompute the closure of an annotation a visitor added to an annotation type by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13042
* Address the Copilot review of the lifecycle interception PR (#13019) by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13031
* Retain the interceptor registrations on every AOP proxy by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13047
* Document the jakarta.annotation.Priority to @Order mapping and its sign by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13051
* Describe the members of a property by the type declaring them by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13040
* test: add regression tests for DefaultBeanContext by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13056
* Make error body buffering for streaming clients configurable by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13055
* fix: match @EachProperty record properties by name by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13058
* A lifecycle event whose bean declares no callback has no target method by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13061
* Decide between bean candidates that are all @Secondary by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13064
